title: On the number of 3APs in fractal sets
summary: We use techniques from the study of the Falconer distance conjecture to explore conditions which guarantee largeness (in terms of bounded $L^2$ density/Lebesgue measure and Hausdorff measure) of the set of lengths of step-sizes of three-term arithmetic progressions which occur within fractal sets, as well as analogous statements in discrete settings. Our main result is a version of Łaba and Pramanik's result in arxiv:0712.3882 that relies only on an assumption of a lower bound, $δ$, on the mass of the measure $μ$ together with an upper bound, $M$ on the $L^q$ norm of its Fourier transform…
